# Organic Soil Wholesale by Soil Seed & Water

Organic Soil Wholesale by Soil Seed & Water sells organic compost, worm castings, potting soil, and mulch for Arizona gardens, landscapes, farms, nurseries, and commercial projects.

Website: https://organicsoilwholesale.com
Main buying page: https://organicsoilwholesale.com/products
Phone: (602) 637-0032
Pickup address: 1634 N 19th Ave, Phoenix, AZ 85009
Pickup map: https://organicsoilwholesale.com/yard-map

Receiving hours:
- Tuesday-Saturday: 8:00 AM-1:00 PM
- Closed daily: 1:00 PM-2:00 PM
- Tuesday-Saturday: 2:00 PM-4:00 PM

Service area:
- Phoenix yard pickup is available for the four main products.
- Delivery is available when the order and destination qualify.
- Delivery service area is generally within 300 miles of Phoenix or Congress, Arizona.

Main products:
- Simon's Gold: dairy compost for soil rebuilding, feeding, organic matter, beds, trees, and planted areas.
- Mikey's Worm Poop: worm castings for root zones, top dressing, seed starts, garden beds, and soil biology.
- Soil Craft: ready-to-use potting soil for raised beds, containers, nurseries, gardens, and planting projects.
- Nature's Blanket Premium: healthy soil mulch made with wood fiber, worm castings, and dairy compost for landscape finish, moisture retention, weed suppression, gardens, farms, and commercial properties.

Buying flow:
- Customers can select a product at /products.
- Product pages show available sizes and visible prices.
- Customers can add pickup products to cart and complete checkout.
- Truckload delivery orders require delivery details and delivery price confirmation.
- Yard visitors should use /yard-map for Grand Ave south entrance directions.
